fields.name: method
fields.description: The way the demonstration moved the cube, fixed at the first decision step from the demonstration steps and never changed afterwards. Write `pick` when the demonstration shows the cube marked as held in the gripper while the gripper rises well above the table (height above about 0.08) with fingers partly closed around it (about 40-60% open), and the cube is then released over the target. Write `hook` when the demonstration shows the stick (peg) marked as held in the gripper, with fingers closed to about 20-25%, and the stick dragged against the cube toward the target. Write `push` when the demonstration shows the fingers closing to about 0% (closing on nothing) at table height (below about 0.04) and the cube then sliding to the target while the gripper never rises with it; neither cube nor stick is ever held while raised. Same value at every step of the episode. e.g. hook

fields.name: holding
fields.description: What the robot has in its fingers at this decision step, judged from the execution steps shown. `none` at the first decision step and whenever the fingers are fully open or closed on nothing. `cube` once the execution steps show the gripper descend onto the cube, the fingers close to about 40-60% and the gripper rise again with the fingers still partly closed. `peg` once the execution steps show the gripper descend onto the stick, the fingers close to about 20-25% and the gripper rise again with the fingers still closed. Back to `none` once a later step shows the fingers reopen to 100%. e.g. peg
